summary: Bitmine Immersion Technologies, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten offering of 3,500,000 shares of 9.50% Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock at a public offering price of $80.00 per share, with total proceeds of $280 million before expenses. The preferred stock carries a stated $100 liquidation preference and cumulative weekly dividends at 9.50% per annum. The company retains redemption rights at prices declining from 110% to par over time; holders may require repurchase upon a fundamental change. Listing on NYSE (symbol BMNP) is applied for. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
